note: Learned layer over foundation's HI-Graph. foundation is the literature prior and is never edited; everything here was produced by measurement inside the loop.

subject: Case Assignment
Specialize
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment and Specialize are a HARD_CONFLICT because they are exact opposites on shared activities.
contradictions.measured_said: Both CA-002 and SPC-001 were applied successfully in Phase 3 and the model was built, although their shared activity showed contention.
evidence: get_pair_relation reported HARD_CONFLICT with condition_fires=true and shared activity W_Complete application
Phase-3 outcome: CA-002 applied=true
Phase-3 outcome: SPC-001 applied=true
Full-plan W_Complete application waiting increased with z=24.71; removing SPC-001 in confirmation improved waiting with z=-2.61
contradictions.note: The edits are structurally co-buildable; the evidence supports a contention or capacity risk, not a legality-level incompatibility.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak positive time impact because assigning a case to one resource reduces handover overhead.
contradictions.measured_said: The time effect is not uniformly positive: CA-001 caused significant throughput deterioration and self-contention, while CA-002 was contended and CA-004 had improved waiting but flat attributable throughput.
evidence: CA-001 attributable throughput worsened by +0.4181 h/case, z=6.56
CA-001 waiting rose at A_Incomplete with z=4.53 and A_Validating with z=10.03
CA-002 produced A_Concept queueing with z=3.55 and net throughput was nonsignificant
CA-004 improved waiting at O_Returned with z=-11.67 but attributable throughput was not significant
contradictions.note: Revise the time prior toward context-dependent or neutral for pool merges, explicitly accounting for self-contention and resource-pool capacity.

subject: Contact Reduction
contradictions.prior_said: Contact Reduction's principal time saving is exogenous and must be reported separately rather than added to simulated throughput.
contradictions.measured_said: CR-002 had flat simulated throughput and worse resource load, while the log separately estimated 9.9686 h/case of removed waiting; the two results were not netted.
evidence: CR-002 simulated throughput was flat and resource load was significantly worse
Log estimate for CR-002 was 131.1652 h per occurrence and 9.9686 h/case
Phase-3 outcome: CR-002 applied=true
The round explicitly reports the estimate separately from simulation
contradictions.note: The exogenous-saving boundary in the prior held up; no correction is needed.

subject: Case-based Work
contradictions.prior_said: Case-based Work should remove batching delays, improve time, and may worsen cost or resource load because batching economies are lost.
contradictions.measured_said: CBW-002 improved waiting, duration, and throughput but worsened resources.
evidence: CBW-002 waiting improved with z=-6.90
CBW-002 duration improved with z=-3.07
CBW-002 attributable throughput improved by 0.3282 h/case, z=-5.29
CBW-002 resources moved significantly worse
contradictions.note: The measured direction matches the prior, including the resource-load tradeoff.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak positive time impact because assigning one case to one resource reduces handover overhead.
contradictions.measured_said: The time effect was not reliably positive: CA-001 significantly worsened sole-owned throughput, CA-002 created significant self-contention, and CA-004 had flat attributable throughput.
evidence: CA-001 throughput worsened by +0.5202 h/case, z=7.16
CA-001 waiting increased at A_Incomplete, z=3.94, and A_Validating, z=9.91
CA-002 A_Concept waiting increased, z=4.79
Phase-3 built CA-001, CA-002, and CA-004 successfully
contradictions.note: Revise the time impact from weak_positive to context-dependent or neutral; assignment can reduce handovers only when the resulting resource pool does not self-contend.

subject: Specialize
contradictions.prior_said: Specialize may improve service time, but any queueing caused by restricting the resource pool must be measured rather than assumed.
contradictions.measured_said: The specialist evidence showed a strong service-time separation, while the reported W_Complete application contention demonstrates why queueing must be decided by measurement rather than the service-time estimate.
evidence: Specialist versus all-resource service-time separation was significant, z=7.25
The prior explicitly distinguishes service-time gain from queueing risk
SPC-001 was not present in the Phase-3 built candidate list, so no Phase-3 build contradiction was established
contradictions.note: The prior's service-time-versus-queueing distinction remains appropriate; do not convert the contention observation into a refutation of the service-time component.

subject: Contact Reduction
contradictions.prior_said: Contact Reduction has a strong positive time impact and a weak positive cost impact; its exogenous waiting-time saving is reported separately from simulation.
contradictions.measured_said: Built candidate CR-002 had flat measured throughput and significantly worsened resource load, while the log separately estimated 131.1652 hours saved per occurrence of waiting_time_before.
evidence: Phase-3 built CR-002 successfully
CR-002 resource load worsened with z=7.1 and z=6.8
CR-002 simulated activity change was +0.0029 h/case, while the exogenous estimate was 9.9686 h/case
contradictions.note: The simulated evidence does not significantly refute the time-impact prior because throughput was flat and the exogenous estimate is not comparable to simulation; however, the significant resource harm cautions against treating the candidate as an unqualified improvement.
